name: Gold-Silver Ratio Mean Reversion (aggressive tilt)
description: Two-asset long-only tilt between gold (SGLN) and silver (SSLN) with aggressive positioning. Monthly. Exploits mean reversion in the gold/silver price ratio. High ratio (silver cheap) tilts to silver; low ratio (gold cheap) tilts to gold. Uses z-score with 250-day lookback and aggressive tilt gain (k=0.30) with wider weight band (10%-90%) for stronger directional tilts.
